October update: confirmed data findings

Checked 21 October 2026 new patch. These are companion-site findings, separate from official patch notes.

What has been checked

Patch data are not in-game verified. New Patch contains the additions below. Unchanged website datasets are not automatically verified for this patch.

With new level cap at 3,600, the stats calculator and My Tatari now support recorded account levels 1–3,600. The Horde / Goldrush calculator remains a fixed level-500 comparison.

Bonobean and account levels

Bonobean, Titanape, Grangutan and Primakong are now integrated across My Tatari, the database, stats calculator, evolution planner, Horde guide/drafter and tierlist tools.

Horde Season 3 configuration

The S3 lists Difficulties 1–6. The obtained data show Difficulty 6 has twice Difficulty 4’s enemy ATK and HP; DEF increases by a smaller amount.

Collectible additions

Original and color accessory variants are present for Zapup, Sparkit, Pandaroo, Cheerling, Lullely, Funglet, Taptail, Budboo, Cavyzap, Ringtail and Popa.

CategoryAdditions
Exclusive Tatari backgroundsFive
Chat emojisPunchimp, Snowcub and Bonobean
Expression bubblesVoltkit, Hootlet, Momopo, Glowfly and Poakie

Halloween and battle setup

Trick-or-Treat reward configuration and the strings “Trick-or-Treat Time!” and “Halloween Fun!” are present. The event dates and exact replacement schedule remain unknown, so the site calendar has not been updated yet.

All 429 new and 404 changed battle setups are now mapped and included in the website’s battle dataset. The changed setups affect 404 stages in chapters 24–29. Of the new files, 404 preserve earlier setups under new references for later chapters; 25 contain Season 3 Horde waves. Enemy level, star and ATK/DEF/HP multiplier records are unchanged.

Confirmed chip updates

The 49 chip catalogue entries, qualities, uniqueness and allowed-wave lists are unchanged. Four numeric changes occur in linked Skill records.

ChipPrevious valuePatch 165921
AFK300 energizers400 energizers; still 40 seconds
First-Aid Kit15% lost HP12% lost HP; still every 4 seconds on the first two rows
Lawn Care40% Max HP percentage damage35%; mower count and initial non-boss kills unchanged
Mission Reset200 energizers per recalled Tatari180 energizers
Backend SupportOne Tatari in frontExplicitly one of your own Tatari; still 45% damage boost

Shuffle still grants 600 energizers and will shuffle from both the deployed and undeployed Tatari pool. Contract Employees stay deployed, and their Tatari types are now excluded from the replacement pool. Ordinary replacement units inherit the replaced slots’ grid positions and Horde levels.

Other Horde mechanics and limits

  • All eight deployment/upgrade costs, death refunds, rank stat multipliers and skill unlock indexes are unchanged.
  • Energy recovery is unchanged: start at 400, initially gain 25 every 5 seconds, decrease the periodic gain by 5 every 90 seconds, and gain 4 per normal kill or 100 per boss kill.
  • The rank, season-rank and wave reward tables and the balance table are unchanged.
  • Horde’s configured level reference remains 500. Normal account-level inputs accept 1–3,600.
  • New parameters 39 and 40 remain unknown.

86 existing Horde detail entries changed, but many edits only correct labels, formatting, historical comparison values or buff/nerf arrows. Those display edits must not be counted as additional combat changes.

Still unverified
